scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.dev:mcp: node init && npm run dev -w mcp-server
scripts.build: node init && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w mcp-server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w mcp-server
scripts.build:server: node init && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start:server: node init && concurrently "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
